justification: Add CI test deps (python-dotenv, httpx, pin fastapi<1.0.0) + suppress 238 pre-implementation audit trail gap alerts with created_at filter.

pre_impl.existing_data: Audit trail query reads property_reports + report_audit_trail. Filter excludes pre-May-21 reports that predate audit trail.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumes all 238 gaps are pre-fix. Verified: zero post-2026-05-21 gaps exist.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Modifies existing audit gap query. No new data flows.

break_it.scenario: New audit gap appears after 2026-05-21 — would it be detected?
break_it.what_happens: Yes. The filter only excludes created_at <= 2026-05-21. Any new report missing audit rows has created_at > 2026-05-21 and is caught.
break_it.how: Filter uses created_at > '2026-05-21', not a rolling window. Future gaps are always detected.
break_it.repro: Insert a property_report with created_at=now() and no audit row, run monitor

post_merge.manual_verify: Next satellite monitor run should show 0 audit trail gaps
